create or replace package body fiscal_calendar as
  function year_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return extract(year from p_date) + case when extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then 1 else 0 end;
  end year_of;

  function quarter_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return case
      when extract(month from p_date) between 7 and 9 then 1 -- July, Aug, Sep -> Q1
      when extract(month from p_date) between 10 and 12 then 2 -- Oct, Nov, Dec -> Q2
      when extract(month from p_date) between 1 and 3 then 3 -- Jan, Feb, Mar -> Q3
      when extract(month from p_date) between 4 and 6 then 4 -- Apr, May, Jun -> Q4
      else null
    end case;
  end quarter_of;
end fiscal_calendar;
/
